simple.summary: אֲבָנָה (ʼĂbânâh) means Abanah , a river near Damascus First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 5 12.

definitions.full: H71. Abanah אבנה Kt 2Kin 5:12 see אֲמָנָה . אַבְנֵט see בנט . אַבְנֵר see אֲבִינֵר below II. אָבָה .
